title.zh: 将拉古纳省 Pakil市镇 Durado小村改设为名称为Durado of Said市镇村的村的法案
title.en: An Act to Convert the Sitio of Durado in the Municipality of Pakil, Province of Laguna, into a Barrio to be Known as the Barrio of Durado of Said Municipality
title.orig: An Act to Convert the Sitio of Durado in the Municipality of Pakil, Province of Laguna, into a Barrio to be Known as the Barrio of Durado of Said Municipality

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1677_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of Durado in the Municipality of Pakil, Province of Laguna, is hereby converted into a barrio to be known as the barrio of Durado of said municipality.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 20, 1957.
